decisions.reason: The load-haul-dump loader line remains a core option for the underground business and keeping it costs little relative to the option value it preserves.
The construction site dumper is still an open option in a familiar construction segment, and while results are uncertain, the cost to keep it is modest.
The inclined furniture lift remains an unproven niche option, but keeping it preserves a low-cost option while demand uncertainty persists.
The inclined building material lift is more closely tied to the firm's construction and industrial customers, so it is kept as a promising option with moderate uncertainty.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift overlaps with the existing furniture lift option and after three years has not shown enough differentiated demand to justify the higher cost of keeping the truck-mounted variant, so the option is abandoned.
